summary: Complete architecture and implementation plan for the AI-Powered Children's Coloring Book Generator. Features customizable age tiers, high-resolution line art generation with gemini-3-pro-image-preview (1K/2K/4K resolution selection), a multi-turn Gemini 3.8 Flash creative brainstorming companion, an interactive digital coloring canvas with brush and bucket fill, and printable multi-page PDF compilation with a personalized cover page.
